c1.title: The gathering
c1.body: At UPAEP, World Space Week closed, the Space Year began, and the Antorcha rocket was handed over.

c2.title: An alliance that opens the path
c2.body: Twelve conveners invite more people in. No one owns the Pact. Whoever joins helps write it, on equal terms.

c3.title: Where the work points
c3.body: Public science, Puebla industry, space tech startups, talent aligned with industry, and links with the country and the world.

c4.title: Three dates
c4.body: The Manifesto is already issued. Adhesion for the signing closes on November 13. The Pact is signed on November 30.

c5.title: What is required is will, not prior experience
c5.body: You write to the Startup and Innovation Cluster, naming a representative and a contribution. The Manifesto does not require resources.

tagline.line1: Puebla is joining the aerospace value chain.
tagline.line2: No single institution can do this alone.

a1.title: Science outreach
a1.body: Bring space science and technology to the public and awaken scientific vocations.

a2.title: Industry in Puebla
a2.body: Bring Puebla industry into the aerospace value chain.

a3.title: Space tech entrepreneurship
a3.body: Turn scientific and technological projects into startups with a business model.

a4.title: Talent and industry
a4.body: Align training and academic capacity with what industry needs.

a5.title: Connection
a5.body: Connect Puebla’s ecosystem with the aerospace sector in Mexico and abroad.

d2.body: Deadline to join and be included in the signing.

adhesion.title: Join the Pact
adhesion.body: Adhesion is in writing to the Startup and Innovation Cluster. Name a representative and a contribution. Prior aerospace experience is not required. To be included in the November 30 signing, the letter must arrive by November 13, 2026.
adhesion.note: The Manifesto is a statement of will. It creates no legal, financial, or budget obligations.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Does the Manifesto require me to put up money?
faq.a1: No. It creates no financial or budget obligations. If resources, facilities, or technology come later, that is formalized in a separate agreement.
faq.q2: Do I need aerospace experience to join?
faq.a2: No. What is required is the will to contribute from education, research, industry, a chamber, a cluster, or a community.
faq.q3: How long do I have to join?
faq.a3: Until November 13, 2026, if you want to be included in the November 30 signing.
faq.a4: UPAEP, SECIHTI Puebla, the Startup and Innovation Cluster, INAOE, the National Coordination of World Space Week, SEDETRA, CTS, the Central Zone Automotive Cluster, CANACINTRA Puebla, Sintonía, Yankuilotl, and REGENIA.
faq.a5: The Pact for the Development of the Aerospace Sector in Puebla is signed and the Coordinating Committee is installed. Conveners and those who have joined take part.
faq.q6: Where do I see the year’s activities?
faq.a6: In the agenda on this page and in the site calendar. Notes live in the journal.
